verified_facts: HMLR polygon data is captured against British National Grid
polygon coordinates are X/Y values on British National Grid
Google and Bing use different projections
BNG to WGS84 conversion may shift some features
official warning states shift can be up to 15 metres
measurement should retain native BNG before any display reprojection
quality_effect: Keeps candidate geometry measurement in native BNG and prevents web-map reprojection displacement from contaminating parcel sampling.
